draft.title: Taccuino del giorno · 26 settembre 2026
draft.excerpt: Cinque spunti dal giovane calcio italiano: talenti che confermano le loro ambizioni, chi cerca spazi e chi insegue i sogni di casa.
draft.excerptEn: Five highlights from Italian youth football: talents confirming their ambitions, those seeking playing time, and those chasing dreams of home.
draft.bodyIt:
**Honest Ahanor**
L'esterno diciottenne si è già conquistato la titolarità al Crystal Palace e attira già lo sguardo del Chelsea: il prossimo passo è consolidare questa posizione nei Reds. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxQZVJDWERBWUlXSFRFOHoxYk9jb3VEUUZMTTdSR0ZGVG0wbXo5UHlIek5sbWRFWFk4d1VMQnRLSzkyYlJncFo0dHoxR3dOeXZRRF9fYjNqZnlnQTFmcl95UEVCa25nZmJMaTNGekJ1MEFNM21fR0tsQ203ZncwT1hOMmk2TElSS2lKSGlBbENaR3pfMXpCYk5YRHUwVURaZjFmSDN5NndwT0FXVjRyNk1r?oc=5)

**Matteo Cichella**
Tra le certezze dell'Under 21 e il desiderio visceral di vestire la maglia giallorossa, il giovane difensore guarda ai modelli che hanno segnato il club: Totti e De Rossi non lasciano scelta. [fonte](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Vincenzo Prisco**
Il Napoli conta su di lui come centrale di prospettiva: il direttore Marino lo promuove a elemento decisivo in casa azzurra, un nuovo tassello della difesa partenopea. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxQTEFnYUZxM1FCV3dzRmdzamt6RktIcEFucGJIS0h1NGgxRVN6bDc0REt5cmk3RXlMaHJjWFJHSC1wU0FDelhLNUF1M3FxZnZmbEVXOHpBX1JPX1loSk5mUUhhMG1hWmNDeXBPUmM1bHhTMzhZZ3NDdnUzQk1TVllNakZyYnhMbXNnWVJUc2VMODlSbGVubkdfbm1LZWdzZ25hR0pTS09HU1R6XzBoVTB2bjZuaFBJUy1ETXRHczhEX09DcU9OUFhz?oc=5)

**Alessandro Dellavalle**
Il terzino non rientra nei piani del Torino, che però vede altri club di Serie B interessati al suo profilo: una chance per giocare con continuità e ritrovare fiducia. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNR1BZTTlodDIwNG1VTC1mTE5pM3YxVlFBMUlhZFFDdVdqLTg1ZFRlaUtuajlaNWN4aTJwd3U2MDZkb2ItR0hmaFJDTzFTMl85bVZBck9XTlBXZVZuLWdNWU5JeWZTVGdsU2VDRmZOQ2ozSUpSTEVFY1hINHE4TmRJM1BaUTd1Z1hDTHJKUUhlWnBVTkk5ZmdXOTAteVlkbm8?oc=5)

**Tommaso Berti**
L'ambiente formativo che cresce i talenti non si limita al rettangolo verde: anche l'educazione e la preparazione al domani contano per chi punta ai massimi livelli. [fonte](https://news.google.?oc=5)

Una giornata che fotografa la realtà dei giovani talenti: chi conferma, chi cerca spazi, chi guarda al presente con determinazione.

**Honest Ahanor**
The eighteen-year-old winger has already earned regular starting status at Crystal Palace and is already attracting the attention of Chelsea: the next step is to consolidate this position among the Reds. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxQZVJDWERBWUlXSFRFOHoxYk9jb3VEUUZMTTdSR0ZGVG0wbXo5UHlIek5sbWRFWFk4d1VMQnRLSzkyYlJncFo0dHoxR3dOeXZRRF9fYjNqZnlnQTFmcl95UEVCa25nZmJMaTNGekJ1MEFNM21fR0tsQ203ZncwT1hOMmk2TElSS2lKSGlBbENaR3pfMXpCYk5YRHUwVURaZjFmSDN5NndwT0FXVjRyNk1r?oc=5)

**Matteo Cichella**
Between the certainties of Under 21 football and his visceral desire to wear the Giallorossi shirt, the young defender looks to the models who have defined the club: Totti and De Rossi leave no choice. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Vincenzo Prisco**
Naples is counting on him as a central defender with genuine prospects: director Marino has promoted him to a key player in the Partenopei setup, a vital piece of the Campania side's defence. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxQTEFnYUZxM1FCV3dzRmdzamt6RktIcEFucGJIS0h1NGgxRVN6bDc0REt5cmk3RXlMaHJjWFJHSC1wU0FDelhLNUF1M3FxZnZmbEVXOHpBX1JPX1loSk5mUUhhMG1hWmNDeXBPUmM1bHhTMzhZZ3NDdnUzQk1TVllNakZyYnhMbXNnWVJUc2VMODlSbGVubkdfbm1LZWdzZ25hR0pTS09HU1R6XzBoVTB2bjZuaFBJUy1ETXRHczhEX09DcU9OUFhz?oc=5)

**Alessandro Dellavalle**
The fullback is not part of Torino's plans, but several Serie B clubs are keen on his profile: a chance to play regularly and rebuild confidence after falling out of favour. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNR1BZTTlodDIwNG1VTC1mTE5pM3YxVlFBMUlhZFFDdVdqLTg1ZFRlaUtuajlaNWN4aTJwd3U2MDZkb2ItR0hmaFJDTzFTMl85bVZBck9XTlBXZVZuLWdNWU5JeWZTVGdsU2VDRmZOQ2ozSUpSTEVFY1hINHE4TmRJM1BaUTd1Z1hDTHJKUUhlWnBVTkk5ZmdXOTAteVlkbm8?oc=5)

**Tommaso Berti**
Developing talent goes beyond the pitch: education and preparation for the future also matter for those aiming at the highest levels. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)

A snapshot of young talent reality: some confirming expectations, others seeking opportunities, all focused on the here and now with determination.
